nodes.description: Public address state variable storing the contract owner, set in the constructor.
Public mapping(address=>uint) holding player balances, credited and debited by withdraw/challenge flows.
Public address state variable holding the current leader of the game.
Constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender and initialises leader = owner.
View function returning balances[player] for a supplied address.
View function returning the current leader address.
Withdraw function that zeroes the caller balance then transfers the amount to msg.sender.
Payable challenge function using blockhash-derived randomness to pick a winner and update balances/leader.
External caller-controlled address used as owner, player, leader and transfer recipient.
External value transfer to msg.sender in userWithdraw; potential callback entry point.
Weak randomness source: uint(blockhash(block.number - 1)) combined with leader and msg.sender addresses.
Arithmetic credit balances[msg.sender] += 100 finney on winning branch.
Arithmetic credit balances[leader] += 95 finney and balances[owner] += 5 finney on losing branch.
Address parameter of publicGetBalance used to look up a balance.
Local variable in userWithdraw caching balances[msg.sender] before zeroing.
Local variable in userChallenge holding the pseudo-random value used for the branch condition.

edges.reason: msg.sender is assigned to the owner state variable in the constructor.
msg.sender is the recipient of the external transfer in userWithdraw.
msg.sender address is hashed into the random value in userChallenge.
msg.sender selects the mapping slot credited with 100 finney on the winning branch.
Stored balance value determines the amount sent by the external transfer.
Local amount variable is passed to the external transfer call.
userWithdraw reads and writes the balances mapping.
publicGetBalance reads the balances mapping.
Caller-supplied player parameter indexes the balances mapping.
player parameter is the input of the publicGetBalance view function.
leader address is mixed into the random value computation.
Winning branch (random % 2 == 1) executes the credit to msg.sender balance.
Losing branch (random % 2 == 0) executes the leader/owner payouts.
userChallenge computes the random value during execution.
userChallenge may execute the msg.sender balance credit.
userChallenge may execute the leader and owner balance credits.
userWithdraw transfers funds to msg.sender at the end of its execution.
External transfer can re-enter the contract's withdraw function.
owner address receives the 5 finney fee on the losing branch.
leader address receives the 95 finney payout on the losing branch.
leader is used as the defender and can be overwritten by msg.sender on the winning branch.
Local random variable stores the derived random value from the unsafe source.
msg.sender participates in and pays for the challenge game logic.
msg.sender keys the balance check and update in userWithdraw.
balances mapping is mutated by the winning-branch arithmetic credit.
balances mapping is mutated by the losing-branch arithmetic credits.
publicGetState returns the leader state variable.

normalization_plan.reason: The player parameter exists only as input to publicGetBalance and should be folded into that core function node.
The amount local variable is a temporary alias of balances[msg.sender] inside userWithdraw and merges into that function node.
The random local variable is a temporary of the userChallenge randomness computation and merges into that function node.
